name: MaryTTS
description: MaryTTS compares component archive MD5 values with its XML component descriptions. This is a content-integrity control; independent authentication of those descriptions is not established by the retained review.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot, not the historical MaryTTS release under study.
The XML publisher/release-side authentication and any package-loading behavior after download were not independently audited; MD5 equality alone is not treated as publisher authentication.
